# NandaGuessr

> Browser game about guessing anime, manga and game characters. Every day there is a new character to find by traits, pictures, frames or quotes. Twenty two worlds — Naruto, One Piece, Attack on Titan, Bleach, Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen and more — plus an endless mode, daily puzzles, duels between players and seasonal leaderboards. The interface is available in Russian, Ukrainian and English at /ru, /uk and /en.

## Modes

- [By traits](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/naruto/classic): name the character, each guess shows which traits match
- [By picture](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/naruto/image): a zoomed fragment opens up with every wrong answer
- [Which of two](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/naruto/pair): two characters and a trait, decide who has it
- [Odd one out](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/naruto/odd): find the character who does not share the hidden trait
- [Guess the anime](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/shots/shot): four frames from hardest to easiest, name the title
- [Manga page](https://nandaguessr.com/en/play/manga/page): name the title by a single page

## Pages

- [All games](https://nandaguessr.com/en): every world grouped by category
- [Leaderboard](https://nandaguessr.com/en/leaderboard): best players of the season
- [Duels](https://nandaguessr.com/en/duels): play against another person in real time
- [Achievements](https://nandaguessr.com/en/achievements): what can be earned
- [Terms](https://nandaguessr.com/en/terms)
- [Privacy](https://nandaguessr.com/en/privacy)

## Notes

- Unofficial fan project; characters and images belong to their rights holders
- Game data comes from community wikis listed in the footer
- The /api/ path is for the game client and is closed to crawlers
